### Meaning
| infl. | class  | meaning                             |
| ----- | ------ | ----------------------------------- |
| ~     | *n.*   | confusion, the unknown, mystery     |
| ~en   | *v.*   | to confuse, to mystify, to bewilder |
| ~a    | *psv.* | confused, mystified, bewildered     |
| ~an   | *adj.* | confusing, puzzling, mysterious     |
